ios.desc:
BeanBook is a free coffee app for specialty coffee lovers. Keep a coffee journal, organize your beans with a coffee tracker, explore coffee recipes, and follow the coffee world in the Coffee Feed.
Remember what made each cup great. Save your photos, tasting notes, grind settings and brewing details together, from your morning pour-over to a memorable café visit.

YOUR COFFEE LIBRARY
- Beans, Brews, Recipes and Gear live in one library, a swipe apart.
- One + button adds a bag, brew, recipe or gear from any page.
- View, sort and filter each page from one menu next to search.
- Open My Coffee Wrapped, your coffee year, in one tap (Pro).

THE COFFEE FEED
- Read facts and real voices from the coffee community on new beans and gear, daily, each with its sources, quotes and key notes.
- See what coffee people are arguing about in Hot takes, and vote in the Daily Poll.
- Catch new coffee drops and deals from roasters in your region.
- Save stories to read later.

YOUR COFFEE JOURNAL
- Record home brews and café visits with photos, notes and ratings.
- Track dose, ratio, grind, water temperature and brew time.
- Log the water and mineral drops you brewed with.
- Send Brew Calculator's ratio, water and pours straight into a Brew Log.
- Attach beans, Gear and recipes to each Brew Log.
- Save a setup as a template (gear, recipe, numbers and steps) and start your next brews from it (Pro).
- Customize sections and backgrounds to make the journal your own.
- Changes save as you edit.
- Revisit your cups in list or grid view, see every brew on a check-in calendar and every café on a map.

YOUR COFFEE TRACKER
- Scan coffee bags with AI to fill in the roaster, origin, process and tasting notes.
- Track roast dates, resting time and how each bag is aging.
- Pause the roast clock while a bag is frozen.
- See how much coffee is left in each bag as you brew.
- Match your beans to jars with numbered or custom container labels.
- Remember your favorite coffees and keep a history of finished bags.

EXPLORE COFFEE RECIPES
- Discover brewing methods and save your own coffee recipes.
- Keep dose, ratio, grind settings and temperature ready for your next brew.
- Start a Brew Log from a saved recipe.
- Calculate water amounts for two to five pours with Brew Calculator.
- Follow your brew with the built-in timer.
Find recipes for Hario V60, AeroPress, Hario Switch, OXO Rapid Brewer, V60 NEO, NextLevel Pulsar, Deep27, Origami, Orea, Chemex, French Press and Cezve.

show_hn.title: Show HN: We're two coffee nerds who built an AI app to track beans and recipes

quotes.text:
It’s available on iOS now:
https://itunes.apple.com/app/id6499280064

We got into specialty coffee during COVID and, like many others, fell deep down the rabbit hole. Along the way, we ran into the same frustrations:

- A drawer full of empty coffee bags.

- No simple way to track grind size, rest dates, notes—by bean.

- My coffee history scattered across photos, screenshots, notebooks, and half-memories.

- The unique traits, people, and stories behind each coffee disappearing from the internet once it sold out (since coffee is an agricultural good)

- In our opinion, no coffee tool really captures the flavor, emotion, and aesthetic of great coffee—from a design perspective.

So we built BeanBook—a coffee notebook log beans, extract recipes, and organize your coffee life in one place with just a snap, powered by AI

Here’s what it does:

-  Snap a bag → Auto-detects roaster, origin, process, roast date, notes, producer, farm, and more

-  Paste a YouTube link or photo → Extracts a structured recipe automatically

-  Log grind size, roast timeline, ratings & notes → All saved in a clean, elegant UI

-  See your coffee year in review → Track habits, trends, and favorites

-  Ask BeanBook AI → From brew temps to bean facts, get instant answers

My co-founder and I built everything ourselves—branding, code, and UX design. If you’re into coffee (or trying to get more into it), we’d love your feedback.

- Rokey & Eric
